title: Partial Localization and Multifractality in Heterogeneous Population Growth with Resetting
abstract: arXiv:2610.22038v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study a model of heterogeneous multiplicative growth with mean-field redistribution and independent local stochastic resetting. The model describes populations or wealth distributed over sites with quenched growth-rate heterogeneity, while resets represent random local extinction or bankruptcy events. At large redistribution or resetting rate, we find a delocalized phase and we compute the growth rate as well as the stationary distribution of the population of a given site. We show that reset-free growth episodes generate power-law stationary tails with site-dependent exponents. For weak resetting and redistribution, favorable sites can undergo long reset-free episodes and localize. This produces a partially localized phase, in which a finite fraction of the total population is carried by a small set of sites whose identity changes on an $O(1)$ time scale within a subextensive pool of $N^{u^\star}$ favorable candidates, with $0<1$.

translated_title: 带重置的异质种群增长中的部分局域化与多重分形性
translated_abstract: 我们研究了一个具有平均场再分布和独立局域随机重置的异质乘性增长模型。该模型描述了分布在各格点上、增长速率具有淬火异质性的种群或财富，而重置则代表随机的局域灭绝或破产事件。在较大的再分布或重置速率下，我们发现了一个离域化相，并计算了增长速率以及给定格点种群的稳态分布。我们证明，无重置的增长阶段会产生具有格点依赖指数的幂律稳态尾部。在弱重置和弱再分布的情况下，优势格点可以经历长时间的无重置增长阶段并发生局域化。这产生了一个部分局域化相，其中总种群的有限比例由一小部分格点承载，这些格点的身份在 O(1) 时间尺度内于一个包含 $N^{u^\star}$ 个优势候选格点的亚广延池中发生变化，其中 $0<1$。
tldr: 该研究在带随机重置的异质乘性增长模型中发现了一个新的部分局域化相——总种群的有限比例由一个亚广延规模的优势格点池承载，且这些格点的身份在 O(1) 时间尺度内不断更替，同时无重置增长阶段会产生具有格点依赖指数的幂律稳态分布。
en_tdlr: This work reveals a novel partially localized phase in heterogeneous multiplicative growth with stochastic resetting, where a finite fraction of the total population is carried by a subextensive pool of favorable sites whose identities change on O(1) timescales, with reset-free growth episodes generating power-law stationary tails with site-dependent exponents.
